summary: Implemented a deterministic fixture-only multi-snapshot paper portfolio replay. The new command processes local live-shaped snapshot objects in chronological order, adapts each snapshot, runs intake/scoring/review/paper planning, carries paper positions forward, blocks duplicate paper orders for an existing market/side position, applies fixture settlements, and emits JSON or Markdown with preserved rejection records and safety flags.
limitations: Fixture-only local snapshot series; no live fetcher, network call, external API call, or live market integration is implemented.
Paper order creation, duplicate blocking, carried positions, settlements, exposure, and PnL are deterministic local calculations only.
No credentials, wallet/private-key access, real orders, real-money execution, runtime wiring, dispatcher/run_codex changes, prompt automation, or live trading path was added.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-019: add a focused offline regression gate for the local snapshot series portfolio replay summary and safety locks.
